# Old maps with ggplot


```{r echo = FALSE}

world <- map_data("world")

# Took a kml from google maps 
#kml_data <- sf::st_read(dsn = resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/Data.kml"))

kml_data <- sf::st_read(dsn = resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/raw/data_input/Data_with_pierron.kml"))

names <- kml_data$Name

# Extracting coordinates
kml_data <- sf::st_as_sf(kml_data)
kml_data <- sf::st_coordinates(kml_data)
kml_data <- data.frame(kml_data)  # Convert to data frame

colnames(kml_data) <- c("lon", "lat")


#Add names
kml_data$Name <- c("Merina","Sakalava","Betsimisaraka","Betsileo","Diego", "Temoro","Vezo","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea")

#worldplot <- ggplot() +
#  geom_polygon(data = world, aes(x=long, y = lat, group = group), fill = "grey")+
#  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(30, 60), ylim = c(-30, -10)) +
#  labs(title = NULL, x= "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
#  geom_sf(data = kml_data, color = "darkblue", fill = "transparent", size = 1) +
#  geom_text(data = kml_data, aes(label = Name), size = 3) +
#  coord_sf(xlim = c(30, 60), ylim = c(-30, -10)) +


worldplot <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), fill = "grey") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(30, 60), ylim = c(-30, -10)) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(kml_data, coords = c("lon", "lat")), color = "darkblue", fill = "transparent", size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(data = kml_data, aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = Name), size = 3, hjust = -0.3) + #nudge_x = 0.1, nudge_y = 0.1
  coord_sf(xlim = c(30, 60), ylim = c(-30, -10))

worldplot
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Assuming 'world' is your dataset with a column 'region' or 'country' containing country names
madagascar <- world[world$region == "Madagascar", ] # Filter for Madagascar

#give other sample a different shape
kml_data$Name <- c("Merina","Sakalava","Betsimisaraka","Betsileo","Diego", "Temoro","Vezo","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea")

ours <- rep(0,5)
pierron <- rep(1,9)
sample <- c(ours,pierron)
kml_data$sample <- sample

# Plotting only Madagascar
madagascar_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = madagascar, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), fill = "grey") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(30, 60), ylim = c(-30, -10)) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(30, 60), ylim = c(-45, -5))+
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(kml_data, coords = c("lon", "lat")), aes(shape = factor(sample)), color = "darkblue", size = 0.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17),labels = c("Our sample", "From literature")) +
   labs(shape = NULL) +
   coord_sf(xlim = c(30, 60), ylim = c(-45, -5))
madagascar_plot

#ggsave(filename="C:/Users/eviec/OneDrive/Documents/Madagascar/Temporary figure/madagascar_pierron_map.tiff", width=7, height=5, units="in",dpi=300)

```

# New plan for map with rnaturalearth

```{r}
#WGS84 standard
Madagascar <- ne_countries(country = "Madagascar", type = "map_units", scale = "medium")

ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = Madagascar)+
  coord_sf(crs = st_crs(29702)) + # Laborde projection, commonly used for Madagascar
  theme_light()

```
